contracts.description: Other computer services. This is a new requirement for the IRSs Business Account and Integrated Data Retrieval System Contractor Support.  Support services will include project management, and development support.

PROJECT MANAGEMENT, OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE SUPPORT TO HELP TO EFFECTIVELY PLAN, TRACK, MANAGEMENT PROJECT ACTIVES, AND DRIVE THE DELIVERY OF INTEGRATION SERVICES FOR INTEGRATION SERVICES FOR INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY (IT) TAX PROCESSING SERVICES.
